report.games:
GAME 1 (on the play). Kept a 1-land hand: Volcanic Island, Lotus Petal, 2 Brainstorm, Force of Will, Pestermite, Deceiver Exarch. Risky, but it has cantrips and both untap creatures.
T1: Volcanic Island, pass. Opp: Polluted Delta into Underground Sea, Delver of Secrets. At opp end step I Brainstorm (City of Traitors, Volcanic Island, Island), keep Volcanic, put back Island, then City on top. No fetch to shuffle them away. Life 20.
T2: draw City. Play Volcanic #2, pass with UU up. Opp: Delver flips, Wasteland on a Volcanic, Aberration hits me (17), Ponder.
T3: draw Island. Play City rather than Island (Island would sacrifice City); now Volcanic + City = 3 mana. Opp combat: I flash Deceiver Exarch and tap Insectile Aberration. Opp main 2: Orcish Bowmasters pings me (16) and makes a 1/1 Army.
T4: draw Kiki-Jiki. Can't cast it: Kiki needs RRR and my only red sources are Volcanic + Petal. Brainstorm is off with Bowmasters out (3 damage + amass 3). Hold City, no land drop. Opp: Murktide Regent, I Force of Will pitching Brainstorm (15). Opp attacks: I flash Pestermite to tap Aberration, Exarch blocks Army, Bowmasters hits (14).
T5: draw Deceiver Exarch #2. Board: Exarch, Pestermite. Kiki + Exarch would be an infinite combo, but it's still RRR-locked. Opp: Bowmasters #2 pings Pestermite dead (Army 2/2). In combat I flash Exarch #2 to tap Aberration; Bowmasters x2 connect (12).
T6: draw Hexing Squelcher. Cast it (Volcanic + City); it only blocks ground. Opp: Brazen Borrower bounces an Exarch. Aberration 3 + Borrower 3 + Bowmasters 1 get through (5).
T7: draw Ancient Tomb. Play Tomb (City is sacrificed), recast Exarch (Tomb takes me to 3). Still 2 red sources, Kiki stays in hand. Opp: two flyers for 6. LOSS. Show and Tell was the next draw and Kiki + Exarch on board was one red mana from winning.

GAME 2 (on the play). Mulligan: the 7 had 2 lands, no cantrips, Kiki (RRR) and two Show and Tell. Show and Tell into Kiki alone does nothing. Took the 7 Tarn / Misty / Force of Will / Ponder / Brainstorm / Imperial Recruiter / City and bottomed City.
T1: Scalding Tarn into basic Island (19). Ponder sees Kiki, Show, Exarch; I order Kiki, Exarch, Show and draw Kiki. Opp: Underground Sea, Delver.
T2: draw Exarch. Play Misty Rainforest, crack it on opp upkeep for Volcanic (18). Opp: Delver flips, Wasteland the Volcanic, Aberration hits (15). At end step I Brainstorm (Show, Pestermite, Petal), put back Show and Recruiter. No fetch left to shuffle.
T3: draw Recruiter back. No land: Island + Petal. Nothing castable (Recruiter needs R, creatures need 3). Opp: Bowmasters at my end step pings (14), Aberration hits (11).
T4: draw Show and Tell, no land. Opp: Murktide Regent, I Force pitching Show (10). Opp attacks with Aberration + Bowmasters + Army (5).
T5: draw Pestermite #2. Still 1 land + Petal. Opp adds Brazen Borrower and swings for lethal. LOSS on opp T5 with Kiki, Recruiter, Exarch and Pestermite stuck in hand. Ancient Tomb was the next draw.

problems.problem: Kiki-Jiki costs {2}{R}{R}{R}, but the deck has only 6 red-producing lands plus 3 Lotus Petal, and the red lands are Wasteland targets. In Game 1, Kiki + Deceiver Exarch on board was an infinite combo for three turns and I never had RRR. Hard-casting Kiki is not a real plan against Wasteland decks.

Show and Tell can't assemble the combo by itself. It puts in one card, so Kiki needs an untap creature already in play, and the opponent also gets a free permanent. The Game 2 opener had two Show and Tell and a Kiki and no way to win. Sneak Attack does win alone (R for Kiki, R for Pestermite or Exarch) and should carry the cheat plan, with Show trimmed or cut.

Too few lands for a deck whose plan wants 5 to 8 mana across two turns. There are 15 lands, one of which (City of Traitors) works against land drops. Both games stalled on one or two lands. Only 3 basics means Wasteland hits a dual every game.

Orcish Bowmasters from Dimir Tempo shut off the Brainstorms and kills the 1-toughness Pestermite. The deck has nothing to answer Bowmasters, Delver or Murktide besides 2 Lightning Bolt (never drawn) and Force of Will. Force was spent on Murktide both games just to survive.
Brainstorm with only 7 fetches put cards back that I then had to redraw. In both games it locked lands or uncastable cards on top for the next two draws.
Hexing Squelcher did not earn its slot. It doesn't advance the combo, can't block flyers, and its 2-life ward doesn't stop Bowmasters or Brazen Borrower.
Imperial Recruiter is a 3-mana red sorcery-speed tutor. In a mana-starved, Wasteland-pressured game it stayed in hand and was a pitch card at best.
City of Traitors forced a choice between it and the Island in Game 1 and was sacrificed by Ancient Tomb. It was the worst land in the deck both games.

report.games:
GAME 1 (on the play, kept 7: Auriok Salvagers, Soul-Guide Lantern, Urza's Saga, Chalice of the Void, Cavern of Souls, Lotus Petal, Karn)
T1: Urza's Saga (I). Saga C + Lotus Petal cast Chalice X=1. Opponent Dazes it and I can't pay. Opp: replays Island, casts Delver of Secrets. Me 20.
T2: Draw LED. Saga (II). Cavern of Souls naming Human. Cavern C casts Soul-Guide Lantern, exiling Daze. I can't make a Construct because only Cavern is free to pay {2}. LED held. Opp: Wasteland on Saga before chapter III. Delver flips and hits for 3. Me 17.
T3: Draw Lotus Petal. No land drop. Cast Petal. Cast Salvagers using Cavern (Human, uncounterable) + LED for WWW mid-cast, which discards Karn. Board: Salvagers, Lantern, Petal, Cavern. LED and Karn in the graveyard. The kill is set for next turn: Petal + Cavern pays {1}{W} to loop LED for infinite mana, then loop Lantern to draw into Walking Ballista. At my end step the opponent casts Brazen Borrower's Petty Theft on Salvagers.
Opp T3: Delver hits for 3, then Borrower flashed in as a 3/1 flyer. Me 14.
T4: Draw Plains. I have 3 mana (Cavern, Plains, Petal) and Salvagers costs 4. Pass. Opp: Delver + Borrower deal 6. Me 8.
T5: Draw Chalice. No land. Cast Chalice X=1 off Plains + Cavern to blank their cheap spells. Opp: 6 in the air. Me 2.
T6: Draw Leonardo and cast it. It can't block flyers. Opp attacks for lethal. LOSS. Salvagers never got cast a second time. Both Agatha's Soul Cauldrons and Haliya were still in the library.

GAME 2 (on the play, kept 7: Leonardo, Walking Ballista, Karn, Auriok Salvagers, Plains, Ancient Tomb, Ancient Tomb)
T1: Ancient Tomb casts Walking Ballista X=1. Me 18. Opp: Delver. I ping Delver with Ballista's only counter, so both die.
T2: Draw Agatha's Soul Cauldron. Second Ancient Tomb casts Karn, the Great Creator. Me 14. Opponent Counterspells Karn. Opp: Dragon's Rage Channeler.
T3: Draw Ancient Tomb. Play Plains. Plains + both Tombs cast Salvagers with 1 spare to pay for Daze. It resolves. Me 10. No LED, so Salvagers is just a 3/4. Opp: delves Murktide Regent (5/5 flyer).
T4: Draw Plains and play it. Plains + Plains + one Tomb cast Leonardo and Agatha's Soul Cauldron. The Cauldron has no creature card in any graveyard worth exiling and does nothing. Me 8. Opp: Murktide hits for 5, DRC is held back for Salvagers. Me 3.
T5: Draw Haliya. Plains + Plains + Tomb casts it; Tomb takes me to 1, Haliya's trigger to 2. Leonardo attacks for 2 lifelink, putting me at 4. Opp: Murktide + delirious DRC attack in the air. LOSS. Third Ancient Tomb never played because I couldn't afford the life.

problems.problem: The combo needs Salvagers + LED + an outlet all together, but only 2 LED are in the deck. Karn's -2 has no sideboard to wish from, and Urza's Saga, the only real tutor, dies to Wasteland. In G2 Salvagers resolved and was just a vanilla 3/4 because no LED ever showed up. In G1 casting Salvagers cost the LED mid-cast, discarded Karn, and left me with one shot, which Brazen Borrower erased.

Chalice of the Void fights the deck's own engine. On 1 it counters my own looped artifacts: Soul-Guide Lantern (the draw outlet I found in G1), Pyrite Spellbomb, Pithing Needle and Shadowspear. On 0 it counters LED and Lotus Petal. In G1 the T1 Chalice cost me Lotus Petal to Daze. The T5 Chalice X=1 would have turned off my own Lantern kill if I had ever reassembled the combo.

The lifegain package neither advances the combo nor stops Dimir's flyers. Leonardo arrived on the last turn in G1 and couldn't block Delver or Borrower. Haliya bought 1 life in G2. These are 11 slots that should be LED copies, outlets or removal.

There is almost no interaction against tempo threats. Delver, Brazen Borrower, Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent killed me in the air both games. The only answer was one Walking Ballista ping, and there is nothing that removes a Murktide.

The mana is fragile and painful. Ancient Tomb took me from 20 to 10 by turn 3 in G2 against an aggressive deck. Urza's Saga ate Wasteland in G1, leaving me stuck on 3 mana with a 4-drop in hand. White comes only from 7 Plains, Karakas, Cavern (Humans only) and Petal.

Agatha's Soul Cauldron did nothing. It needs Salvagers already in a graveyard plus a creature with a counter on it, which this matchup never set up. Both copies in G1 were still in the library, and the G2 copy was a blank 2-mana artifact.
Karn is a 4-mana do-nothing here. He has no sideboard targets, his static ability is irrelevant against Dimir, he was countered in G2, and he was discarded to LED in G1.

grade.which: 3. The lifegain package neither advances the combo nor stops Dimir's flyers. Leonardo arrived on the last turn in G1 and couldn't block Delver or Borrower. Haliya bought 1 life in G2. These are 11 slots that should be LED copies, outlets or removal.

report.games:
GAME 1 (on the play) — Kept Mountain, Taiga, Windswept Heath, Farseek, Exploration, Green Sun's Zenith, Scapeshift: three lands, ramp and the win card.
T1: Mountain, Exploration (resolves, no Daze), extra land drop Windswept Heath. 20 life. Opp: Underground Sea, Delver of Secrets.
T2 (draw Prismatic Omen): Taiga, crack Heath for basic Forest (19). Farseek for basic Mountain, 1 mana held up for Daze. 4 lands. Opp: Wasteland on Taiga; Delver unflipped hits for 1 (18).
T3 (draw Prismatic Omen): 3 lands. Omen with 1 open, resolves. Hand: Scapeshift, GSZ, Omen. Opp: Delver flips and hits for 3 (15); casts Psychic Frog.
T4 (draw Forest): Forest, 4 lands. GSZ X=1 for Sakura-Tribe Elder, 2 open. Opp: Delver hits (12); Frog attacks, STE chumps and sacs for Mountain (5 lands). Murktide Regent comes down off a full graveyard.
T5 (draw Farseek): Farseek for Mountain, 6 lands + Omen. Only 3 mana left, so no Scapeshift this turn. Second Omen is dead. Opp: Delver + Murktide hit for 8 (4).
T6 (draw Exploration): Scapeshift with 6 lands and Omen (lethal setup: Valakut + 5 Mountains). Opp Force of Will, pitching a blue card. Nothing left to do.
Opp T6: lethal. LOSS. I never interacted with Delver, Frog or Murktide.

GAME 2 — Opening 7 was Windswept Heath as the only land with Crop Rotation, Farseek, GSZ, 2x Scapeshift, Dryad. One-lander: MULLIGAN.
New 7: Farseek, Dryad, Taiga, 2x Wooded Foothills, Mountain, STE. Bottomed one Foothills.
T1: Mountain. Opp: Polluted Delta into Sea, Delver.
T2 (draw Life from the Loam): Taiga, STE. Opp flashes Orcish Bowmasters at my end step to ping STE; I sac STE in response for Forest. Opp T2: Wasteland on Taiga; Delver hits for 1 (19).
T3 (draw Exploration): Foothills, crack for Mountain (18). Dryad of the Ilysian Grove (3 lands) resolves. Opp: Delver flips and hits (15).
T4 (draw Taiga): Taiga. Farseek for Mountain, then Exploration. 5 lands, no Valakut seen, no Scapeshift or GSZ in hand. Opp: Delver hits (12); Murktide Regent; second Wasteland on Taiga.
T5 (draw Dryad Arbor): Arbor. Loam returns Foothills + Taiga; play both (three drops). 7 lands that are all Mountains, but no Valakut, so it does nothing. Opp: Delver + Murktide hit for 9 (3).
T6: dredging Loam could mill a Valakut, but I'm dead next attack with no blocker for flyers. LOSS. Across the mulligan and 6 draws I never saw a win condition (Scapeshift, GSZ, Titan or Valakut).

problems.problem: The deck has zero answers to Force of Will and Daze, so the entire game rides on Scapeshift resolving. In G1, six turns of setup were undone by one Force. Against the most-played deck, which runs 4 Force and 4 Daze, that is the biggest flaw. A Veil of Summer resolves Scapeshift through blue/black counters, and Dimir's counters and removal are all blue/black.

There is no interaction with Delver, Psychic Frog, Murktide or Bowmasters, and no flying blockers. I was at 4 by T5 in G1 and dead on T6 in both games. Small creatures like STE and Dryad can't block flyers and die to Bowmasters pings.

Too few ways to find Valakut and win. G2 saw 13 cards with no Scapeshift, GSZ or Valakut, so Dryad plus 7 lands that were all Mountains did nothing. The only win routes are 4 Scapeshift, 3 Valakut and 1 Primeval Titan, which needs 7 mana through GSZ. Elvish Reclaimer is a GSZ-able 1-drop that tutors Valakut and the missing piece of the Loam engine. A 4th Valakut would also help.

Prismatic Omen and Dryad do the same job, and extra copies are dead. I drew two Omens in G1 and the second did nothing. Six copies of 'lands are every type' is too many when you only ever need one. Cut 1–2 Omens for protection or interaction.

Life from the Loam only works with Valakut already available. In G2 it returned a Wasteland-ed Taiga and a fetch for zero damage, and it costs a full turn against a clock. Crop Rotation showed up in a one-land opener and only works as a tutor once Valakut payoffs are set up. Both are low-impact against a tempo deck.

Wasteland hit Taiga in both games (twice in G2), which slowed the land count the deck needs. Basics and fetches covered it, but Taiga and Valakut are the only targets and losing a land is costly in a 6–7-land combo. Windswept Heath can't fetch basic Mountain, so it is a weaker fetch here than a 3rd Prismatic Vista or more basics.

report.games:
GAME 1 (on the play)
Mulligan: the opening 7 has 1 land and two 6-drops. The replacement 7 also has 1 land (Island, Intuition x2, Impulse x2, Counterspell, Show and Tell). I bottom Show and Tell and keep 6 rather than go to 5.
T1: Island. Opp: Forest, Utopia Sprawl.
T2: draw Show and Tell, miss land drop, pass. Opp: Argothian Enchantress.
T3: draw Island (2 lands). Opp: Wild Growth (draws), Enchantress's Presence. I Counterspell Presence.
T4: draw Mind Over Matter. Main-phase Impulse (Island, MoM, Opt, Stroke): take Island, play it (3 lands). Opp: Seal of Cleansing (draw), Rancor on Enchantress, hit me to 18. Their end step: Intuition for 3 Ancient Tomb, get a Tomb.
T5: draw Island, play Tomb (5 mana), hold. Opp: Sterling Grove, Rancor hit to 16. Their end step: Intuition for Arcanis x3 (any mixed pile just hands me the weak card), so 2 Arcanis are binned.
T6: Island (4 Islands + Tomb), hardcast Arcanis, Tomb puts me to 14. Opp resolves Solitary Confinement while I'm tapped out. They now have shroud, so Stroke of Genius has no legal target ever again.
T7: Arcanis draws 3. Cast MoM (Tomb, 12 life). Opp sacs Seal of Cleansing and MoM dies. It was irrelevant anyway with Solitary out.
T8-T10: Arcanis draws 3 a turn and I counter a few spells, but mono-blue has no way to remove a resolved Solitary Confinement. Opp assembles Serra's Sanctum + Opalescence. Animated enchantments + Rancor overwhelm Arcanis blocks.
T11: dead. LOSS.

GAME 2 (on the play)
Keep: City of Traitors, 2 Island, Opt, Arcanis, MoM, Cunning Wish.
T1: Island. Opp: Forest, Wild Growth. Their end step: Opt (scry Island, keep), draw Island.
T2: draw Frantic Search, Island. Opp: Argothian Enchantress (no counter in hand).
T3: draw Cunning Wish, Island (3). No sideboard exists, so both Wishes are blanks. Opp: Utopia Sprawl, Enchantress's Presence, draws ~3.
T4: draw Frantic Search, Island (4). Frantic #1: draw Island + Stroke, discard both Cunning Wishes. Frantic #2: draw Arcanis + Mana Leak, discard Island + Arcanis #2. Hold 4 open. Opp: Seal of Cleansing, then taps low for Solitary Confinement. I Mana Leak it and they can't pay. Rancor Enchantress hits me to 18.
T5: draw Impulse. City of Traitors (6 mana): Arcanis. Opp: Mirri's Guile, more enchantments, no attack into Arcanis.
T6: no land drop, to keep City. Cast MoM with 4 Islands + City. Opp sacs Seal of Cleansing in response to the first activation and MoM dies. Tap Arcanis normally: Counterspell, Intuition, Island.
T7: Arcanis draws 3 (Thran Dynamo, Opt, Island). Island (City sacrificed, 5 Islands). Opp casts Solitary Confinement #2; I Counterspell it. Their end step: Intuition for MoM x3, get MoM #2.
T8: Arcanis draws 3, Island (6), cast Thran Dynamo. Opp: Opalescence. Animated enchantments swing; Arcanis blocks one, I go to 9.
T9: cast MoM. Loop: discard to untap Arcanis, draw 3, discard to untap Dynamo (3 mana per card). With ~25 cards in opp's library I need X=25 (28 mana), about 9 spare cards. My library barely covers it. Stroke for 25. WIN, at 9 life, only because their second Seal/Aura of Silence or Solitary never showed up.

problems.problem: The deck's only win condition is targeted Stroke of Genius. Enchantress's Solitary Confinement gives the opponent shroud and turns the whole combo off. Mono-blue has zero answers to a resolved enchantment, so Game 1 was over the moment Solitary landed. The deck needs a way to remove it, such as Capsize (buyback is free once the MoM loop makes mana), or a second, non-targeting kill.

Mind Over Matter is a 6-mana sorcery-speed enchantment that dies to Seal of Cleansing or Aura of Silence. Enchantress plays both main deck because they cantrip off its Enchantresses. In both games MoM was destroyed in response, and the deck has no protection or redundancy. Arcanis also has summoning sickness, so the setup takes two turns and the opponent gets a full turn to prepare.

Cunning Wish has no sideboard to fetch from. Both copies were pure discard fodder in Game 2. Either build a wish board or replace them with Brainstorm, which is also strangely missing from a blue Premodern deck.

Show and Tell has only Arcanis or MoM as payload, and it hands Enchantress a free Solitary Confinement, Opalescence or Serra's Sanctum. It was a card I never wanted to cast and the first one I bottomed.

The mana was poor. Game 1 dealt two one-land 7s in a row; with 6-drops and UUUU costs, 22 lands plus 3 Dynamos is not enough cheap card flow. City of Traitors fights the deck's need for six-plus land drops; I had to skip a land drop to keep it. Ancient Tomb cost 4 life in Game 1 against a deck that wins by beating down with Rancor and Opalescence.

With mostly Islands, each discard to Mind Over Matter makes only 1 mana. The Stroke kill then needs most of your library and risks decking off Arcanis's forced draws. Game 2 only worked because I'd found Thran Dynamo. Three Dynamos is too few for how central they are, and Stroke itself (3 copies, can't be discarded during the loop) is fragile.

Intuition has no graveyard synergy here. Triple-copy piles just bin two of your three Arcanis or Mind Over Matter, and any mixed pile hands you the weak card. It worked as an expensive tutor for one copy, and in Game 1 it cost me two Arcanis.

Mana Leak is weak against Enchantress, whose land auras give it lots of spare mana. It only worked once, when the opponent tapped low. Hard counters, or Force of Will to protect the combo turn, would be better.

grade.which: 8. Mana Leak is weak against Enchantress, whose land auras give it lots of spare mana. It only worked once, when the opponent tapped low. Hard counters, or Force of Will to protect the combo turn, would be better.

report.games:
GAME 1 (kept: Wildfire x2, Birds, Wall of Roots, Forest, Sylvan Library, Wasteland. Two lands plus two mana creatures plus Library, but no threat in hand.)
T1: Forest, Birds of Paradise. Opp: Forest, Utopia Sprawl.
T2: draw Bolt. Wasteland; Wall of Roots (Forest+Wasteland), then Wall counter + Birds into Sylvan Library. Opp: Plains, Argothian Enchantress + Wild Growth (draws 1).
T3: Library sees Wasteland/Karplusan/Bolt; keep Wasteland, put Karplusan + Bolt back. Play Wasteland #2 (5 mana, nothing to cast; Bolt can't target the shrouded Enchantress anyway). Opp: Serra's Sanctum, Enchantress's Presence, Mirri's Guile, drawing off triggers.
T4: Library sees Karplusan/Bolt/Mox Diamond; keep Karplusan, put Bolt + Mox back (no spare land to discard to Mox). Wasteland the Sanctum. Karplusan + Birds for RR (Wall to 0/2): Wildfire. I sac all 4 lands. Opp sacs Forest, Plains + 1 (Sprawl/Wild Growth fall off). 4 damage kills my Birds, my Wall and their Argothian Enchantress. Life 19.
Opp T4: keeps Presence, Guile, Sterling Grove; replays a land.
T5-T6: Library digs Bolt/Mox/Forest/Forest; pay 4 once (life 15). Rebuild with Forest, Mox Diamond (discarding Forest), Forest. Still no threat; Bolt only goes face (17).
Opp T5-T7: lands + Wild Growth, Presence cantrips refill, Sterling Grove fetches Solitary Confinement, cast T7. Bolts now dead.
T7-T8: draw Wildfire #3. Second Wildfire possible around T9, but it locks nothing that matters: I have no creature to win with.
Opp T8-T11: rebuilds behind Confinement, Replenish, then Opalescence + Rancor beats.
RESULT: Loss. Saw ~13 cards, zero Terravore or Kavu Titan. Three Wildfires and two Bolts did nothing to a board of enchantments.

GAME 2 (kept: Birds, Wooded Foothills, Wasteland, Wildfire, Terravore, Mountain, Bolt.)
T1: Foothills fetches Forest (19), Birds. Opp: Forest, Utopia Sprawl.
T2: draw Wall of Roots. Mountain; Wall of Roots (Forest+Birds), holding Bolt. Opp: Argothian Enchantress (shroud, Bolt can't touch it).
T3: draw Forest. Forest; Terravore (1/1, Foothills in yard), 2 mana open. Opp: Plains, Enchantress's Presence + Wild Growth, draws 2.
T4: draw Forest. Forest; Mountain + Birds for RR, Wall counter: Wildfire. I sac 4 lands, they sac all 3; Birds, Wall and Argothian Enchantress die. 8 lands in yards: Terravore is 8/8, survives the 4 damage, attacks: opp 20->12.
Opp T4: Forest, Wild Growth (cantrip).
T5: draw Birds. Wasteland (colorless), Birds (sick, so no red for Bolt). Terravore attacks: 12->4.
Opp T5: Plains, Solitary Confinement. Terravore damage prevented, Bolt can't target them.
T6: draw Mountain. Bolt still dead. They discard each upkeep, refilling only via Presence cantrips.
T7-T8: draw Foothills, Sylvan Library; Library digs for Stone Rain/Thermokarst to starve their mana so they can't cantrip.
Opp T8-T9: out of cards to discard, Confinement goes.
T9/T10: Terravore swings for lethal.
RESULT: Win, but slow and exposed: one more card for them (Swords, Replenish or a second Confinement) and it stalls.

problems.problem: Too few threats that survive Wildfire. Only 4 Terravore + 2 Kavu Titan. Game 1 saw ~13 cards with Library digging and found zero win conditions, so three Wildfires just reset a game I couldn't close. Game 2 was won only because Terravore was in the opener.

Lightning Bolt is nearly blank against Enchantress. Argothian Enchantress and Solitary Confinement both give shroud, and the deck has almost no other creatures. In both games it was only ever face damage or a dead card. Swap it for enchantment hate such as Creeping Mold, Tranquility or Uktabi Orangutan.

No answer to enchantments at all. Solitary Confinement turned off Terravore in Game 2 and won Game 1 for them. Land destruction doesn't touch their engine: Presence, Mirri's Guile and Sterling Grove survive Wildfire and rebuild faster than I do.

The ramp dies to its own payoff. Birds and Wall of Roots are killed by Wildfire, so after the first Wildfire I rebuild from zero just like the opponent. This makes a second Wildfire or a big follow-up slow. Wildfire-proof mana rocks would fix this; Thran Dynamo or Worn Powerstone could replace a creature slot.

The artifact mana underperforms. Mox Diamond was uncastable in Game 1 because the hand had no spare land to discard. Fellwar Stone can't make red against G/W Enchantress, so it never helps cast Wildfire's RR.

Too many colorless lands for a {R}{R} spell. Four Wasteland plus pinging Karplusan Forests left Game 1 with only Karplusan + Birds as red sources, and Game 2 couldn't Bolt on T5 off a Wasteland land drop. Against Enchantress, Wasteland only hits Serra's Sanctum or Yavimaya Hollow, so 4 copies is too many.

grade.which: 4. The ramp dies to its own payoff. Birds and Wall of Roots are killed by Wildfire, so after the first Wildfire I rebuild from zero just like the opponent.

report.games:

T1: Coastal Tower tapped. Opp: Forest, Wild Growth.
T2 (Wrath of God): Strand for Island (19), hold UU. Opp casts Argothian Enchantress; I Counterspell it. Opp plays Exploration and an extra land.
T3 (Ambassador Laquatus): no land. Standstill to dig. Opp breaks it with Enchantress's Presence; I draw Traumatize, FoF, Standstill. Opp casts Seal of Cleansing and draws.
T4 (Swords): still 2 lands. Hold Counterspell. Opp casts Solitary Confinement; I Counterspell it. Opp then resolves Verduran Enchantress + Rancor (draws 2). I discard Laquatus to hand size.
T5 (Adarkar Wastes): Swords on Verduran; Rancor returns. Cast Millstone. Opp Seals it at once. Opp: second Solitary Confinement resolves (no counter left). Opp also casts Argothian Enchantress.
T6 (Adarkar Wastes): 4 lands, Wrath (17 from Wastes). FoF, Traumatize and Standstill are now blank or near-blank. Opp: Sterling Grove, Rancor recast, more Enchantresses.
T7-T9: FoF digs for Disenchant (1 copy), which can't target Confinement through Grove anyway. I trade Swords and Factory with Rancor creatures. Opp keeps discarding excess cards to Confinement.
T10-T11: Opp Replenishes enchantments into play; I take 6-8 a turn.
T12: dead. LOSS. Never milled a single card.

problems.problem: Solitary Confinement gives the Enchantress player shroud, and every mill card in the deck targets a player. It resolved T4 in game 1 and T5 in game 2, and the mill plan was dead from then on. Sterling Grove then gives Confinement shroud, so the lone Disenchant can't answer it. This is a core card in Enchantress and probably the most-played deck the brew will face. Nothing in the deck answers it once it lands.

The deck needs non-targeting answers to enchantments. The only plan was to counter every Confinement and Replenish, but 7 hard and soft counters ran out by turn 4-5 against a deck casting 3-5 spells a turn. Akroma's Vengeance (Onslaught, legal) wipes Confinement, Sterling Grove, Seal and creatures without targeting, and cycles when not needed. It should replace Disenchant and some Swords.

Millstone was destroyed by Seal of Cleansing the turn it came down in both games. That cost 2 mana and a card each time for zero cards milled. Four copies are too many in a field with Seal of Cleansing and Aura of Silence. Millstone also mills only 2 a turn against a deck that draws 3-5 a turn on its own.

Swords to Plowshares underperformed. Argothian Enchantress has shroud, so the main engine can't be targeted. Rancor just returns to hand when its creature dies. Swords only ever hit Verduran Enchantress. Four Swords is oversized for this matchup; Wrath of God carried all the creature removal.

Mana trouble in game 2: stuck on 2 lands from T2 to T4. The deck has 25 lands, but 5 are colorless (4 Mishra's Factory, Dust Bowl) and 3 enter tapped. That doesn't fit UU counters and WW Wrath. Mishra's Factory and Faerie Conclave are beatdown lands in a deck that wins by milling, and Confinement prevents their damage anyway.

Traumatize and other big mill put enchantments straight into the graveyard for Replenish. Replenish resolved in both games and returned Seal of Cleansing, Wild Growth and Exploration. Without graveyard hate or more hard counters, milling feeds their best comeback card.

Mana Leak and Standstill are weak against Wild Growth and Exploration ramp. Leak was only live on T2. Standstill cost a tap-out on T3 both times, and the opponent broke it with Enchantress's Presence, a spell they wanted to cast anyway. In game 2 the 3 cards it drew were all spells, with no lands to fix the screw.
Win conditions that did nothing: Ambassador Laquatus was discarded to hand size and the single Brain Freeze never appeared. Both also target, so they are blanked by Confinement anyway.

grade.which: 6. Traumatize and other big mill put enchantments straight into the graveyard for Replenish. Replenish resolved in both games and returned Seal of Cleansing, Wild Growth and Exploration. Without graveyard hate or more hard counters, milling feeds their best comeback card.

report.games:
GAME 1 (on the play) - kept Volcanic Island, Ponder, Show and Tell, Lotus Petal, Pestermite, City of Traitors, Ancient Tomb. It has the Show plus Pestermite core, fast mana and a cantrip to find Kiki.
T1 me: Volcanic Island, Ponder (top: Kiki-Jiki, Force, Force). Kept the order and drew Kiki-Jiki. Life 20.
T1 opp: Polluted Delta into Underground Sea, Delver of Secrets.
T2 me: drew Force of Will. Played Ancient Tomb and held City of Traitors so I would have 6 mana next turn (Volcanic 1 + Tomb 2 + City 2 + Petal 1). Passed holding Force.
T2 opp: Delver flipped. Aberration hit me (17). Island, Orcish Bowmasters pinged me (16) and made a 1/1 Army. I let it resolve to save Force for the combo turn.
T3 me: drew Force #2. Played City of Traitors and cast Show and Tell (Tomb + Volcanic, 14). Opp Counterspelled. I Forced it, pitching the other Force (13). Show resolved: I put in Kiki-Jiki, opp put in a Murktide Dragon (3/3, no delve).
T3 me cont.: Pestermite (City + Petal for blue). Opp was tapped out and had no Daze, so it resolved. Untapped City, tapped Kiki to copy Pestermite, and the token untapped Kiki. Made infinite hasty fliers, used their ETBs to tap Aberration, Murktide and Bowmasters, and attacked for lethal. WIN on T3.
Note: the win needed every card. With all 6 mana spent and no blue left over, a single Daze on Pestermite would have stranded a lone Kiki in front of Fatal Push.

GAME 2 (on the play) - mulliganed Brainstorm, Imperial Recruiter, Spell Pierce, Island, Stock Up, Imperial Recruiter, Brainstorm (one land, everything else costs 3). Took City of Traitors, Force of Will, Island, Ponder, Show and Tell, Show and Tell, Pestermite and bottomed one Show and Tell. Kept 6 with no Kiki.
T1 me: Island, Ponder (Scalding Tarn, Sneak Attack, Brainstorm). Drew Tarn and set Brainstorm next.
T1 opp: Underground Sea, Delver of Secrets.
T2 me: drew Brainstorm. Cracked Tarn for Volcanic Island (19). Cast Brainstorm main phase while opp had only 1 land, so no flash Bowmasters: drew Sneak Attack, Pestermite, Brainstorm. Put back Pestermite #2 and Sneak Attack. Still no Kiki or Recruiter.
T2 opp: Delver flipped, attacked (16). Orcish Bowmasters pinged me (15).
T3 me: drew Pestermite. Played City of Traitors. Could not Brainstorm into Bowmasters (3 pings plus a 3-power Army), and Show and Tell had nothing worth putting in, so I passed holding Pestermite and Force.
T3 opp: in combat I flashed Pestermite to tap Aberration and took 2 (13). Opp delved Murktide and I Forced it, pitching Show and Tell (12).
T4 me: drew Sneak Attack. With no land drop, I cast Sneak Attack anyway because it was the only proactive play. Pestermite chumps and pecks.
T4-T5 opp: Brazen Borrower bounced Pestermite. Bowmasters, Army and Aberration kept attacking. I had to Brainstorm through Bowmasters at end step (8 life, Army grew) and found Brainstorm, Deceiver Exarch, Force. Still no Kiki.
T6: two Sneak Attacks in play only give hasty 1/1s and a 1/4. Overrun by fliers plus the Army. LOSS. I never saw Kiki-Jiki or Imperial Recruiter.

problems.problem: Kiki-Jiki is a single point of failure. Only 3 Kiki plus 3 Imperial Recruiter can assemble the combo, and every other engine card is blank without it. In Game 2, Show and Tell, two Sneak Attacks, Pestermite and Exarch all did nothing because Kiki never showed up. A Sneak/Show shell needs payoffs that win alone, or more Kiki-style redundancy.

The deck has no standalone Sneak/Show target. Sneak Attack plus Pestermite or Exarch is just a hasty 1/1, and Show and Tell for Pestermite is a joke that also gives Dimir Tempo a free Murktide or Bowmasters. Add Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and/or Griselbrand. Zealous Conscripts is another infinite partner for Kiki that still does something with Sneak Attack.

Orcish Bowmasters punishes the cantrip package hard. Brainstorm and Stock Up became uncastable or cost several life plus a growing Army in Game 2. That slowed the search for Kiki exactly when I needed to dig.

The Show line costs about 6 mana with two blue in one turn (Show and Tell 2U, then Pestermite 2U). It spends everything, so it folds to a single Daze or a second counter. Game 1 only won because the opponent's Counterspell met two Forces and they lacked Daze. A lone Kiki left after a countered Pestermite just eats Fatal Push.

Imperial Recruiter and Stock Up are 3-mana sorcery-speed setup cards in a deck that wants to combo or interact. They clogged a one-land opener that had to be mulliganed. Recruiter only fetches a piece you still have to cheat in, so it is too slow against Tempo.

The colored mana is thin and Wasteland-exposed. Volcanic Island is the main dual, Ancient Tomb and City of Traitors make only colorless, and Kiki's RRR cost is almost impossible to hard-cast. Thundering Falls entering tapped is bad in a combo deck. Game 2 began with a one-land hand.

These cards never appeared, so the games don't judge them. Spell Pierce and Flusterstorm can't stop the creature threats that beat me (Delver, Murktide, Bowmasters). The slots might be better spent on payoff redundancy.

results.note: Think it just barely uses mind over matter, more of a dream halls deck though

report.games:
GAME 1 (mulligan)
Opening 7: Mind Over Matter x2, Dream Halls, Intuition, Rush of Knowledge, Show and Tell, Lotus Petal. No lands, so I mulligan. Kept Frantic Search, Kamahl, Fire // Ice, Svyelunite Temple, Intuition, City of Brass; Rush of Knowledge to the bottom.
T1: Svyelunite Temple, tapped. Opp: Forest, Utopia Sprawl.
T2: Draw Shivan Reef, play it, hold Fire // Ice. Opp: Argothian Enchantress (shroud, so Fire has no target), Wild Growth, draws.
T3: Draw Svyelunite Temple, play City of Brass. Opp: Enchantress's Presence, Exploration with 2 lands, draws 3. At their end step I Intuition for 3 Mind Over Matter and get one. Life 19.
T4: Draw Dream Halls. Frantic Search draws Island and City of Traitors; I discard Dream Halls and the Temple, then untap. Play City of Traitors, sacrifice the Temple for UU, cast Mind Over Matter. Life 16. Hand: Kamahl, Fire // Ice, Island.
Opp T4: Seal of Cleansing, sacrificed to kill Mind Over Matter. Then Solitary Confinement.
T5: Draw Island. I hold it to keep City of Traitors and have nothing to cast. Opp: Sterling Grove, Serra's Sanctum, discards to keep Confinement.
T6: Draw Ancient Tomb and play it (City of Traitors is sacrificed). Opp: Parallax Wave.
T7: Draw Kamahl, play Island, hard-cast Kamahl. Life 12. Confinement prevents all damage to them and Enchantress has shroud, so Kamahl has no real target. Wave removes him.
T8-9: Opalescence turns their board into attackers. Loss.

GAME 2 (keep)
Opening 7: Ancient Tomb, City of Traitors x2, Island, Arcanis, Intuition, Fire // Ice. Keep.
T1: Island. Opp: Forest, Utopia Sprawl.
T2: Draw Svyelunite Temple, play it tapped. Opp: Argothian Enchantress, Wild Growth.
T3: Draw Lotus Petal, play City of Traitors. Island + Temple sacrificed for UU + Petal + City of Traitors = 6 mana: cast Arcanis on turn 3. Opp: Enchantress's Presence, Exploration, draws a pile.
T4: Draw Mind Over Matter. Arcanis draws Frantic Search, Fire // Ice, Show and Tell. Frantic Search off Island + City of Traitors draws Dream Halls and Fire // Ice; I discard City of Traitors and a Fire // Ice, then untap. Tap City of Traitors, play Ancient Tomb, cast Show and Tell and put in Mind Over Matter. Opp puts in Parallax Wave.
T4 continued: I discard to untap Arcanis with Mind Over Matter. In response they fade Wave and exile Arcanis, so the untap fizzles. Life 18. Hand: Fire // Ice, Intuition, Dream Halls.
Opp T4: Seal of Cleansing, sacrificed on Mind Over Matter. More enchantments, Sanctum online.
T5: Draw Fire // Ice. End-step Intuition for Kamahl, Kamahl, Prophetic Bolt. I have only Island and Ancient Tomb (no red source), so Kamahl is uncastable.
T6+: Opp adds Opalescence and Rancor and beats down. Wave counters are held for Kamahl. Loss.

problems.problem: Show and Tell and Dream Halls are symmetric, and Enchantress is the worst deck to hand a free permanent. Show and Tell put in Parallax Wave, which exiled Arcanis in response to the first Mind Over Matter activation. Dream Halls lets them discard a card to cast every Wave, Confinement or Opalescence for free. Both cards are anti-synergistic in this matchup and the most-played-deck matchup matters most.

The only win is damage, and Enchantress shuts that off completely. Solitary Confinement prevents all damage to them and gives them shroud. Argothian Enchantress has shroud too. Parallax Wave removes Arcanis or Kamahl. The deck has no way to remove an enchantment once it lands. Only 3 Arcane Denial stand between the opponent and these lock pieces resolving. Seal of Cleansing killed Mind Over Matter in both games without a fight.

The draw engine is a single copy and is slow. Arcanis is a 1-of with no haste, so Mind Over Matter + Arcanis needs Arcanis to survive a full turn cycle. One Wave counter answered the whole combo. Without Arcanis, Mind Over Matter + Kamahl with a 3-4 card hand deals about 9 damage, not 20.

The mana is bad for the colour requirements. Mind Over Matter needs UUUU and Arcanis needs UUU. Kamahl needs RR, but red comes only from 4 Shivan Reef, 3 City of Brass and Lotus Petal. In game 2 I had Arcanis and Kamahl options but my lands were Island, Ancient Tomb and 2 City of Traitors, with no red source at all. City of Traitors fights every later land drop: twice I held a land to keep it. Ancient Tomb, City of Brass and Reef pings cost 4-8 life per game.
Fire // Ice is close to dead against Enchantress. Their key creature has shroud and their threats are enchantments. Three copies drawn across the games did nothing.

Game 1's opening hand had zero lands. It held two Mind Over Matter plus Dream Halls, Show and Tell and Rush of Knowledge: too many 5-6 mana or situational cards. The deck relies on Lotus Petal and fast lands but still clumps expensive spells. Rush of Knowledge was the first card bottomed and is only good once a 6-drop is already in play.

Intuition, with the opponent choosing, often just means 'tutor the worst copy'. It is good for finding Mind Over Matter, but it cannot assemble the Arcanis + Kamahl package because each is a single copy or 2-of.

grade.which: 3. The draw engine is a single copy and is slow. Arcanis is a 1-of with no haste, so Mind Over Matter + Arcanis needs Arcanis to survive a full turn cycle.

report.games:
GAME 1 (on the play)
Mulligan: Mulch, Mulch, Karplusan Forest, Groundskeeper, Mox Diamond x3 has one real land, and every Mox needs a land to discard. Took the 7: Wild Mongrel, Seismic Assault x2, Wooded Foothills, Mountain, Mox Diamond, Lightning Bolt. Bottomed the second Seismic Assault.
T1: Wooded Foothills, crack for Forest (me 19). Opp: Forest, Utopia Sprawl.
T2 (draw Terravore): Mountain, Wild Mongrel. Opp: Argothian Enchantress.
T3 (draw Forgotten Cave): Mox Diamond discarding Cave. Terravore is 2/2 (Foothills + Cave in yard). Mongrel attacks (opp 18). Opp: Enchantress's Presence + Wild Growth, draws 2.
T4 (draw Karplusan Forest): Karplusan. Seismic Assault off Mountain + Karplusan + Mox (me 18). No lands left in hand to pitch. Mongrel + Terravore attack (opp 14). Opp: Seal of Cleansing, sacrificed right away to kill Assault. Then Elephant Grass.
T5 (draw Gamble): Paid 4 so both creatures could attack through Grass (opp 10). No mana left for Gamble. Opp: Solitary Confinement.
T6-T8 (draws: Forgotten Cave, Karplusan, Foothills): All damage to opp is prevented. Bolt and creatures are blank. Gamble only finds more damage cards. Terravore grows to 4/4 and does nothing.
T9+: Opp feeds Confinement off Presence draws and assembles Replenish/Opalescence. LOSS.

GAME 2 (on the play)
Keep: Harvest Wurm, Mountain, Wild Mongrel, Treetop Village, Lightning Bolt, Wooded Foothills, Gamble.
T1: Treetop Village (tapped). Opp: Utopia Sprawl.
T2 (draw Forest): Forest, Wild Mongrel. Opp: Argothian Enchantress (shroud, so Bolt can't touch it).
T3 (draw Mountain): Mountain. Animate Treetop; Mongrel + Ape attack for 5 (opp 15). Opp: Enchantress's Presence, Sterling Grove.
T4 (draw Bolt): Foothills to Mountain (me 19). Mongrel + Ape attack (opp 10), Bolt face (opp 7). Harvest Wurm is uncastable: no basic in my yard. Opp: Sterling Grove fetched Solitary Confinement at my end step. They cast Confinement + Elephant Grass.
T5 (draw Mountain): Locked. Second Bolt can't go face. Assault would be useless even if Gambled for. Discarding a Mountain to Mongrel to turn on Wurm achieves nothing.
T6-T9 (draws: Mox Diamond, Wild Mongrel, Foothills, Sylvan Library): No way to remove an enchantment. Library just digs for cards that can't affect the board.
T10+: Opp Replenishes/Opalescence and wins through the lock. LOSS (opp was at 7, one attack short).

problems.problem: No answer to enchantments at all against the format's most-played deck. Solitary Confinement single-handedly beat both games. Seal of Cleansing killed Seismic Assault. Elephant Grass taxed every attack. Green has legal answers that should be in the 75 (main or board).

The deck's only damage plan is the opponent's life total. Bolt and Assault can't target Argothian Enchantress (shroud). Every damage source is blanked by Solitary Confinement, and Sphere of Law (a common Enchantress card) would blunt the red damage too. Assault became a 3-mana do-nothing in G1, and Gamble had nothing useful to find.

Four Mox Diamond is too many. It requires discarding a land, so hands with several Moxes are effectively land-light: the G1 opener with 3 Moxes and 1 land was a forced mulligan. Two or three copies is plenty.

Harvest Wurm was dead. Fetchlands don't put basics in the yard, and the deck has few ways to bin basic lands before turn 4. Groundskeeper has the same issue. Without a real recursion engine, these cards don't earn slots.

The mana pulls in two directions. Seismic Assault needs RRR and Terravore needs GG. Assault was only castable on T4 in G1 thanks to Mox, and only by taking Karplusan pings. Treetop Village, Forgotten Cave and Tranquil Thicket enter tapped and slow the race.

Terravore was undersized. It was a 2/2 on turn 3 because only the lands the deck happens to bin (fetches, Mox discards, Assault pitches, Mulch) fuel it. It never mattered against a deck that doesn't care about creature combat once Confinement lands.

G2 lost by a single turn. Speed is the main way to beat Enchantress before the lock, and the deck lacked a clock beyond 2-power creatures and Treetop. Rancor-style pressure or cheap disruption would have mattered more than value cards.

grade.which: 2. The deck's only damage plan is the opponent's life total. ... Assault became a 3-mana do-nothing in G1, and Gamble had nothing useful to find.
